advisories.title: Layer violation: storage -> api
advisories.description: Module "src/storage" (layer: storage, level 0) imports module "src/web" (layer: api, level 2). Inner layers should not depend on outer layers.
suggested_actions: Introduce an interface/port in the inner layer
Move shared types to a common package
Invert the dependency using dependency injection
